title: Restart engine on a CPU Pod: 409 error dialog instead of restarting the engine generations use
description: With a download-only (CPU) Pod connected, generations run on the local engine, but the restart action picked the Pod (isRemote) and the Pod, having no ComfyUI, answered restart-comfy 409 - a Restart failed dialog. Restart must target the engine generations actually use (getEngine's download-only rule) and say so in a toast.
